offering_description.value: Underwrites commercial property and casualty insurance through a group of autonomous specialty operating units. Sells to businesses and institutions in niche markets, mainly via independent agents and brokers. Also offers reinsurance and monoline excess coverage.

primary_products.value: commercial casualty insurance; property insurance; professional liability insurance; workers' compensation insurance; reinsurance

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses, professionals, healthcare and other institutions, and insurers buying reinsurance

end_markets.value: commercial insurance; professional services; healthcare; construction; transportation

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: insurance and reinsurance premiums plus investment income on the insurance float

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: risk-bearing insurer and reinsurer that underwrites policies sold to commercial clients through agents and brokers

geography_served.value: global: United States primary market, plus operations in the UK, Europe, Canada, Latin America, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Scandinavia

specialization.value: related lines: specialty insurance lines, reinsurance and monoline excess, and workers' compensation, run by several specialty units

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent retail and wholesale insurance agents and brokers; direct sales: some reinsurance placed directly with insurers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance underwriting licensed and regulated by state insurance departments and foreign insurance regulators
